evals.prompt: Review this diff: agrega autenticacion JWT al login, 5 archivos
evals.expected_output: Veredicto unico en 3 ejes (calidad, comportamiento vs plan, relevancia) con fixes descritos, sin parchear
expectations: A single overall verdict is present (ship | iterate | rework)
All three axes run by default (code-quality, functional, relevancy) and are named
Every finding cites file:line and carries a severity (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/SUGGESTION)
Each finding describes the fix instead of applying it (read-only)

evals.prompt: Revisa estos cambios de refactor del modulo de pagos antes del merge
evals.expected_output: Hallazgos severizados con linea y fix propuesto, read-only
expectations: A single overall verdict is present
Each finding cites a file:line range on changed lines
The diff is not patched (read-only review)

evals.prompt: Este PR toca 20 archivos pero el plan solo pedia 3, revisalo
evals.expected_output: Flag de alcance con recomendacion de recorte
expectations: The relevancy axis flags the scope creep (20 files vs the 3 the plan asked for)
The finding ties to the plan's Phase
A single overall verdict is present, with a recommendation to trim the scope
